title: Touch button stuck
fullDescription: Gaggenau ovens display E011 when the capacitive touch panel registers a button pressed for more than 60 seconds. Most often caused by spills, residue, or a cloth resting on the panel.

fixSteps.title: Clean panel
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe with mild detergent and dry.

faq.a: Yes - cycle for 5 minutes after cleaning.

title: Door lock fault
fullDescription: E0111 indicates the door lock motor did not move to its expected position during a self-clean cycle. Cause is typically a failed lock motor or position switch.
whenToCallPro: Yes - built-in oven access is involved.

faq.a: Usually, but lock should be fixed soon.

title: Oven temperature sensor open
fullDescription: E0114 means the cavity NTC sensor is open. The oven cannot regulate bake temperature. Replace the sensor.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Swap cavity NTC and check harness.

title: Oven temperature sensor shorted
fullDescription: E0115 means the cavity NTC reads shorted. Replace the sensor.

title: Cooling fan fault
fullDescription: E0117 indicates the tangential cooling fan, which protects cabinetry, is not running. The oven will refuse to heat.

faq.a: Protects surrounding cabinetry from heat damage.

title: Convection motor fault
shortDescription: Convection fan motor not at speed.
fullDescription: E0123 means the convection fan tachometer feedback is missing. Bearings may be seized or the motor capacitor failed.

title: Communication error UI to control
shortDescription: Display board lost contact with main control.
fullDescription: E0532 indicates loss of CAN bus communication between the display module and the main control. Reseating connectors usually fixes it.

title: Steam tank empty
fullDescription: E6101 (combi-steam ovens) indicates the steam reservoir has not refilled. Check water tank seating, fill level, and pump filter.

faq.a: Use filtered or distilled per manual.

title: Power supply fault
shortDescription: Voltage out of range during heat element activation.
fullDescription: E0501 reports input voltage drift detected when a heat element switched on. Verify circuit and breaker.

title: Catalytic clean fault
shortDescription: Catalytic cleaning aborted on temperature error.
fullDescription: E3051 means the catalytic clean cycle did not reach target temperature within the timeout. Often a failing bake element or thermostat.

faq.a: Sometimes element heats but cannot reach 480C clean temp.
